discovery.summary: Check a Pennsylvania business address against registry evidence
discovery.description: Resolve a Pennsylvania business name to a unique strong registry entity and compare the supplied address with the registry address using U.S. Census geocoding. Returns match or human_review. A match is not proof of physical presence, control, good standing, ownership, authority, fraud risk, sanctions status, creditworthiness, or legal compliance.
discovery.resource_description: Check whether a supplied Pennsylvania business address matches the selected Pennsylvania registry entity using official registry and Census geocoding evidence. Returns match or human_review; it does not prove address control, ownership, good standing, or legal/compliance status.

buyer.task: Check whether a submitted Pennsylvania business address is consistent with the address of a uniquely resolved Pennsylvania registry entity.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

example_query.address: 600 North Second Street, Suite 401, Harrisburg, PA 17101

sources.authority: Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
sources.refresh_policy: live lookup on each paid request
live comparison on each paid request after strong registry match

rules: Require a unique strong Pennsylvania registry match.
Require both submitted and registry addresses to geocode.
Require matching primary street number and ZIP.
Require geocoded distance at or below 0.25 miles.
Return match only when all checks pass; otherwise return human_review.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Commercial promotion remains blocked until complete unit economics meet the target or an explicit exception is approved.
